Name: Microsoft Entra ID Assets
Author: Microsoft
Description: Microsoft Entra ID Assets enriches security investigations with asset and relationship data. The preview Microsoft Entra ID Assets connector ingests inventory into onboarded Entra system tables in a Log Analytics workspace; the legacy data-lake connector is deprecated. Includes Parser for Microsoft Entra ID Assets for query-time camelCase to PascalCase alignment. Existing connections and history are not migrated automatically. The legacy connector supplies Purview data risk graphs; replacement compatibility must be confirmed before disconnecting it. See the [migration guide](https://github.com/Azure/Azure-Sentinel/blob/master/Solutions/Microsoft%20Entra%20ID%20Assets/README.md).
